64세 남성, atrial fibrillation onset으로 입원함. Hemodynamics 불안정함.

BP 88/54 mmHg.  
HR 142 bpm.  
RR 22 breaths/min.  
BT 36.9°C.  
SpO2 94% room air.  

Severe palpitations 호소함.  

Diltiazem 20 mg IV STAT 투여함.  

Electrical cardioversion 시행함.  

C-line 유지함.  

IV fluids 1500 mL 투여함.  

의식 명료함.  

Cardiology team notify함.
